provenance.tls-hrr: Go 1.22.12 crypto/tls native client and server, P256-only server, X25519-first client. Real loopback capture. Keylog is ephemeral fixture-only material. Wireshark 4.4.8 independently identifies CH1/HRR/CH2/SH.
provenance.redis-reply: Redis 7.2.5 native server, standard-library Python RESP client; socket reply and silence oracle. OFF/ON, SKIP, repeated SKIP, ON override, prior pipeline and ACL denial. Isolated ACL setup has no parser role evidence.
provenance.dns-lan: Controlled RFC-encoded Python UDP peers, not an independent DNS daemon. Literal dot versus two labels, ASCII case, real IPv4 multicast LLMNR query and unicast response. Port 19553 requires explicit DNS DecodeAs; LLMNR port 5355 auto-admitted. IPv6/multiple responder/flow reuse negatives are separate constructed unit tests.

limitations: TLS HRR PSK binder changes explicitly unsupported; no certificate trust claim.
Redis CLIENT REPLY inside transactions requires context; ambiguous error responses do not get guessed associations.
LLMNR responder matches are observations, not authenticated identities.
